english.note: Use this for the peppermint hard-sweet sense.
Use this specifically for a mint-flavored candy, especially one eaten to freshen the breath.

examples.english: I loved eating a striped humbug when I was little.
examples.traditional: 我細個最鍾意食一粒有條紋嘅薄荷糖。

examples.english: After eating garlic, have a mint before going back to work.
examples.traditional: 食完蒜頭，含粒薄荷糖先好返工。
